cases.gold_mapping: OC or clausal object analysis, depending on course policy
cases.rule: Non-finite clause predicated of an object can function as OC.
cases.sentence: I heard her sing.

cases.explanation: Do not blindly map all obl/PP spans to A.
cases.rule: The same surface PP may be adverbial or nominal modifier depending on meaning.
cases.sentence: George smashed a window in his father's car.

cases.explanation: This type is useful as a regression-test case for the remapper.
cases.rule: In the teaching analysis, the temporal expression after copular “be” functions as SC.

cases.teaching_note: Keep this as a guarded regression case for the automatic remapper even though the gold label is SC.
